name: JitForge
tagline: High-performance in-memory Java JIT & bytecode synthesis engine.
description:
JitForge is a high-performance in-memory Java runtime compilation, JIT execution, and cloud-native bytecode synthesis engine. Compiles and executes dynamic Java code in RAM with zero disk I/O, sub-millisecond caching, a 4-tier storage hierarchy, and AST sandboxing.

Core Architecture:
- Cloud-Native REST Microservice: Built on Java 21 Loom Virtual Threads for high-concurrency compilation (/api/compile) and execution (/api/execute).
- Dynamic Multi-Engine: Supports JAVAC, ultra-low-latency JANINO (<15ms JIT), and Apache Groovy (@CompileStatic).
- 4-Tier Distributed Bytecode Storage: RAM/ClassLoader (<1µs) -> Redis Cache (<1ms) -> Pod Local Volume (2-5ms) -> PostgreSQL DB (5-15ms).
- URLClassLoader Bytecode Streaming: Direct HTTP bytecode streaming (/api/classes/...) allowing remote JVMs to load compiled classes on the fly.
- Sandboxed Execution: Lexical AST rule validation and SandboxedExecutor with strict millisecond timeouts.
